message.content:
The capital of Australia is **Canberra**.

It's a purpose-built capital located in the Australian Capital Territory (ACT), chosen as a compromise between rivals Sydney and Melbourne back in 1908. Many people assume it's Sydney or Melbourne — the largest cities — but Canberra has been the seat of Australia's federal government since 1927.
